guide.name: Figma OAuth Setup and Launch Guide
guide.summary: Configure OAuth app for Figma API access
guide.timeNote: Planning estimate, not a measured setup duration. Assuming existing OAuth callback and Figma developer account
guide.review: Figma reviews public OAuth apps, private apps don't require review, draft apps are for testing only, public apps can be used by any Figma user, private apps are limited to the associated team or organization
guide.scopeNote: Minimum scope for reading file JSON contents is file_content:read

steps.title: Create OAuth App Draft
steps.detail: Go to figma.com/developers/apps, click My Apps, and create a new OAuth app draft. Enter a name and select a team or organization. Copy the Client ID and Client Secret. The OAuth app will be in a draft state, allowing you and admins to test it. (Source: s1)

steps.title: Configure OAuth App Settings
steps.detail: Go to figma.com/developers/apps, click the OAuth app, and configure settings. Add a redirect URL, select the file_content:read scope, and choose private or public app type. Ensure the scopes match the endpoints you're making requests to. (Source: s1, s2)

steps.title: Test OAuth App
steps.detail: Test the OAuth app with a Figma user account. Ensure the app can read file JSON contents using the GET /v1/files/{key} endpoint. Use the authentication URL https://www.figma.com/oauth?client_id=:client_id&redirect_uri=:callback&scope=:scope&state=:state&response_type=code. (Source: s1)

steps.title: Confirm readiness before external launch
steps.detail: Confirm the intended app type, allowed scopes, and any unresolved provider review requirements with the provider before external rollout. If the cited documentation does not settle eligibility, send provider support your audience, planned actions, and exact scopes. Submit a review only if the provider confirms it is required; do not promise a launch date while this is unresolved.

blockers.title: Figma Review Timeframe Unknown
blockers.detail: The timeframe for Figma to review and approve a public OAuth app is unknown. Plan accordingly and consider testing with a private OAuth app first. (Source: s1, s2)
blockers.resolution: Wait for Figma review and approval or consider using a private OAuth app

blockers.title: Public OAuth App Approval Criteria Unclear
blockers.detail: The criteria for Figma to approve a public OAuth app are unclear. Ensure the app meets Figma's guidelines and requirements. (Source: s1, s2)
blockers.resolution: Review Figma's guidelines and requirements for public OAuth apps and ensure the app meets them

blockers.title: OAuth App Configuration Errors
blockers.detail: Errors in configuring the OAuth app can prevent it from working correctly. Double-check the configuration settings and test the app thoroughly. (Source: s1, s2)
blockers.resolution: Review and correct OAuth app configuration settings

blockers.title: Figma API Endpoint Errors
blockers.detail: Errors in using the Figma API endpoints can prevent the app from working correctly. Review the Figma API documentation and ensure the app is using the correct endpoints. (Source: s1, s4, s5)
blockers.resolution: Review Figma API documentation and correct endpoint usage
